text:
Your vault is protected by several layers of security that run quietly in the background. Everything in it is encrypted with AES-256, the same standard banks and governments around the world rely on. Your encryption key is derived from your master password using PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations, so guessing the password is extremely slow and expensive for an attacker, even with powerful hardware.

Your master password also never leaves your device. Our servers never see it, so there's nothing for a hacker to steal from us. Only encrypted data is stored in the cloud, and only you hold the key to unlock it. You still get fast, convenient access to your passwords on all your devices, with privacy built in. Your digital life deserves this kind of protection, and we're proud to provide it.
